title: See the connection and the audit checks

steps.text: Agent audits reads your agent platform with a read-only key. Claude Managed Agents is the only platform today.
This is where you would save the key. It is encrypted and never shown again.
Below the connection are the checks. Each one says whether it reads the platform or an uploaded file.
Open a check to see the latest result for each system.
Run leads to the evaluation page, where the check is started on a registered system.
